title: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:27940:20170320:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 27940, March 20, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date on which 10 days have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.) Public notifications, dispositions, or other acts made before this Decree enters into force by the head of the former local government or an agency under that person's jurisdiction in relation to an area incorporated into another local government under this Decree shall be deemed acts made by the head of the local government newly having jurisdiction over the area or an agency under that person's jurisdiction. Applications, reports, or other acts submitted to the head of the former local government or an agency under that person's jurisdiction shall be deemed to have been submitted to the head of the local government newly having jurisdiction over the area or an agency under that person's jurisdiction.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations) Where another statute or regulation in force when this Decree enters into force designates all or part of an autonomous district area changed under this Decree as an area or jurisdictional area, the relevant statute or regulation shall apply, until it is amended after this Decree enters into force, as if that area still belonged to the autonomous district's area or jurisdictional area before the change.
